close_reason: Folded into fz-k22.23 and landed in 8cb9b7a90. Direct-call evidence remains separate from first-class construction/publication inventory.
description:
Folded into fz-k22.23 before implementation. Direct/public registry separation cannot be verified independently because a construction's CallableId can have several producer-owned specializations. A singleton direct identity causes native closure call target disagreement; choosing by consumer target is unsound.

Retained discovery
The final fz-k22.23 model needs producer-scoped member sets carried from FunctionRef/Lambda construction, direct ABI authority distinct from BoundaryId publications, and lazy closure wrappers only for real materialized values.

Closure condition
Close as folded when fz-k22.23 lands this coherent model and full gates pass.
title: Separate native direct-call authority from published callable inventory
